Description: Diego, get the contract through legal review and signed by end of next week, and confirm the AV package includes recording in all three rooms, last year we lost the breakout talks because recording was main-hall only.

Description: I'll chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week, we need it for the website and the printed program.

Description: I'll run the email campaign in three waves: agenda announcement when Bo locks the lineup, early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, and a final-week push. I'll draft all three this month, and the first wave goes out the day the agenda is live.

Description: Bo, once the lineup locks, hand the bios and headshots straight to Diego for the landing page update, same day, don't sit on them.

Description: Order's ready to place: 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers, comes to about 9,200 with the rush buffer. I just need your sign-off on the design proofs, they're in the shared drive.

Description: I'll review the proofs today, and once I approve, you place the order this week, lead time was six weeks last year, we're already cutting it close.

Name: Next check-in with lineup locked and contract signed
Description: Next check-in same time in two weeks, with the lineup locked and the contract signed, please.
